10109010.t: Vermont Outdoor Stage

*Sigh*... Never mind. If anyone's going out there, it really should be me...
Right? Didn't we do great?
I never said you did great!
As noisy as ever. I could hear every word from over there. ???
What, are you entering too?
No. It would be unfair for those of us who serve Harmonix to take part.
Right... All your followers would vote for you.
But this is an event for all of Vermont. We could hardly sit it out, so we're helping run it.
Celestial is handling crowd control, while Feelharmony is managing event operations.
So I'll find Ines over by the stage.
Correct. I think... she would be pleased to see you.
Now, I should check the area. Please let me know if you see anyone suspicious.

Well, a lot has happened. Plus, this is her home turf.

Well, yeah... It feels kinda suffocating here sometimes!

Really? I'm happy anywhere!
Yeah, you're an exception.
It's good to see you getting along so well. What brings you all the way here today?
Just ended up here. Are you entering too?
Hehe, so you came to enter the contest. And against your will, no less...

I'm afraid not. I have no need to enter a contest like this...

Aronne?
Hehe. You're joking, surely. She'd never get up on stage.

Isabel?

Even if we hire someone, you are not picking them!
Ugh... I can't keep up with you all.
By the way, where is everyone else? Why are you walking around alone?

I was checking all the places she might be when I spotted you.
Oh, so you're looking for a lost kid?
I'll help, but it'll have to be a paid job.
Hehe... Charging me in my hour of need. How delightfully mercenary of you.
Though I suppose that is only natural for a Fixer... Would a glass of something good cover it?
That's all?
Of course, I do know a few ways to get your help for free.
If I use my abilities...
Haha... How could I ask for payment when we're searching for such a treasure?
Aronne's smile is the greatest reward I could ask for.
Hehe... What a smooth talker you are.
Theta, find the lost-child center.
Initiating search...
...? What gives? Why'd you freeze?
The crowd appears to be slowing the connection. Signal quality was already poor. Please stand by...
Search complete. The office beside the stage is also serving as the lost-child center.
Alright, shall we head over?

10109020.t: Lost-Child Center

Sounds like you got her out of one mess and straight into another...

...? What do you mean?
Nothing. Anyway, why were you waiting for me?

You should've called to check!

Well, you're here now. We look forward to seeing you on stage. And...

May I see my girl now?

M-Mom...!!

I-It was fun playing with you, Aronne!
What's going on between you and Feelharmony? Everyone's acting weird.
Hehehe... I haven't done a thing.
It's simply that our family and the Harmonix Faith are like oil and water—we just don't mix.
...People get the wrong idea about you just for existing? Reminds me of a certain corporate big shot.

Someone is rapidly approaching from above.
Aronne! Are you in here?!

It does a mother's heart good. Hehehe...
M-Mom?! No... I mean...
I-I just came to tell Aronne off! Getting lost because she's so careless...!
Says the one who flew here at top speed because she was worried.
Shut up! That's not true at all!
Alright, Aronne! Let's hear what excuse you have this time!!
Eek... I-I'm s-sorry...
Speak up! I can't hear you when you squeak like that.
You're Mom's successor! How many times do I have to tell you to speak up and act confident?
U-Ugh...
Ugh, stop shrinking back like that...!
*Sigh*... This is why I can never leave home...
If you're that worried about Aronne, why don't you just become the successor yourself?
You...! Nobody asked you! I've got plenty to do, you know!
I was practicing, and then I had to worry about you... Just stay put and don't get into trouble, alright?!
Why is she so prickly? Is she going through puberty or something?
Perhaps so. Heheh...
Huh? Puberty with a figure like that? Just how old is she—

Then... Does that mean you too, Aronne?
Hehe. That's enough about age. Aronne still has plenty of growing to do.
Anyway, Boss! The contest's about to start!
Are you waiting backstage until your turn, Boss? Or coming to watch with us?
If we're late, we won't get good seats!
It'd be such a shame to come all this way and not enjoy it properly!
A tragedy on par with visiting a bakery and missing the free samples.
We must decide now.
You make everything sound urgent. What are you even hoping to see at this contest?
Haha... We just want to get your big moment on camera, Boss!
Exactly! We're definitely not collecting embarrassing footage of you, <:player>!
We'll just film the contest, cut together a promo for the agency, and post it online for everyone to see!
Recording systems checked. Ready whenever you are.
*Sigh*... You do your thing. I'll do mine.
Come. We should find our seats. People have already preordered the footage, so I intend to get a clear recording.
Who the hell pre-ordered that?!
Hehehe... Well, we should find our seats too.
Oh, check on Isabel for me, won't you? She loses track of time when she gets absorbed in something.
Why me? I'm busy enough looking after myself.
Oh? Afraid you can't beat Isabel fair and square?
I'm not falling for that. I didn't even want to enter this contest...
But... As a paid job, I suppose I could manage it.
Hehe... A job it is, then. Come by Bloody Mary afterward, and I'll make sure you're well looked after.
Isabel is third, by the way. Don't be late.
...That's pretty early.
They went by signup order. She must have been eager, don't you think?
Come along, Aronne. Stay close. We don't want to lose you again.
Yes...! I'll stay close this time...
Um... I'm looking forward to seeing you on stage, <:player>.
And please tell my sister I'm really excited to see her performance too.
Why didn't you just say so yourself earlier?
Well... There was so much going on... Please make sure you tell her...!
*Sigh*... Now, how am I going to handle that troublemaker...?

be like her?
